_: Farm buildings, Sun Haven style. Each has tiers; a tier needs a PERMIT bought at the Town Hall (Alder) plus materials, then takes `days` to construct (Hazel's crew works overnight). `upgrade_of` chains tiers. `unlock` gates: building skill level, a story quest, friendship.
